payload.text: **0088 row 2: a gated tool never reads input -- run_gate hands it </dev/null, with no override key** (hv, 2026-09-18, taking vc's recommendation). A terminal run takes the path agents and CI already take, and a tool that wants an answer fails the same way everywhere. vc's census found no gate in the fleet that reads input (51 scripts; Prolix iex/dbproxy exec, not gates). An override is added only when a real gate needs one. vc builds, dc reviews; named in the sweep pre-notice.
